protocol.question: At which forecast horizons does weather information add skill for aggregate wind-farm power, and how much of the oracle upper bound does a genuinely available forecast capture?

arms.persistence: latest available power (issue - 20 min) per turbine, summed; reference
arms.gfs: scada + GFS ws_hub,dir_sin,dir_cos,ws10,gust,t2m,sp at target valid time
arms.era5: scada + ERA5 ws_hub,dir_sin,dir_cos,ws10,gust,t2m,sp at target valid time; ORACLE upper bound, not a forecast

model.family: LightGBM regression_l1, one pooled-horizon model per turbine, farm = sum
model.selection: inner early stopping on last 28 training days, then refit all training rows with selected trees

gfs_rule.fallback: previous eligible runs, at most 2, if a needed step file is missing
gfs_rule.time_interpolation: linear between 3 h steps of the same run, on u/v components
gfs_rule.space_interpolation: bilinear over enclosing 0.25 deg cell, on u/v components
gfs_rule.hub_wind: GFS 80 m u/v directly (hub height 80 m)

era5_rule.source: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive, 4 enclosing grid points, bilinear
era5_rule.hub_wind: 100 m speed * (80/100)^alpha, alpha = median log-ratio of 100 m/10 m speed on hours before test start

split.label_rule: row (issue,h) enters a training set only if issue + h + 20 min < boundary
split.exposure: 2015 was the A3 final evaluation year; not a blind test of earlier models

protocol.rows: identical keys for all arms: label complete for all 4 turbines AND SCADA, GFS and ERA5 inputs all valid; applies to training and scoring; dropped counts reported

metrics.accuracy_note: approximates, does not replicate, Chinese provincial assessment rules
metrics.improvement: MAE % vs persistence and vs scada arm

bootstrap.method: paired non-circular 7-day blocks over full test calendar, percentile CI

metrics.capture: (MAE_scada - MAE_gfs) / (MAE_scada - MAE_era5), only where era5-scada CI < 0

decision_wording.gfs: 'GFS 在 h 显著改善' only if the 95% CI of MAE(gfs) - MAE(scada) is entirely < 0; 'GFS 在 h 显著变差' if entirely > 0; else '未检出差异（区间含0）'
decision_wording.era5: same rule with '先知 ERA5' wording; never called a forecast
decision_wording.summary: list the horizons satisfying each statement; no pooled significance claim
